title: Remove Completed table duplicate title meta
summary: Remove the muted duplicate filename/title line from Completed output table title cells and make TV row titles prefer concrete season/episode labels while retaining full-path tooltip evidence.
reason: The Completed table repeated each output title in light grey with the container extension, and TV rows could collapse to generic labels such as TV (Season 01), adding visual noise without enough episode context.
behavior_before: Completed output rows showed the primary title and a secondary muted filename/path-derived line, such as the same title repeated with .mkv. TV rows could show generic season-only labels such as TV (Season 01).
behavior_after: Completed output rows show only the primary title in the title column. TV rows prefer concrete episode labels such as Show - S02E01 - Episode when row path or season/episode evidence is available; the full output/source path remains available through the cell tooltip and selected-row details.

rollback_plan: Restore the Completed table title-cell meta span rendering and remove the focused title-cell smoke test.
notes: UI-only WebView rendering change; no backend media policy, queue, publish, rename, settings, source, scratch, or output file behavior changed.
